paragraphs: R. Yehudah ben Nerya. Tanchuma, Tetze, and Eikhah Midrash, on “Repay them a recompense,” have ben Gadya. Taanit, chapter 3, halakhah 10, has R. Yudan Gidya in the received report. [The checked text at 3:9:4 reads Yudan Giraya.] Jerusalem Maaser Sheni, chapter 4, halakhah 2: and R. Yaakov son of R. Bun. [At 4:1:10 in the checked edition, the two names appear together.] R. Yehoshua ben Levi said, “I learned from him sixty laws about plowing over a grave”—so too Rabbah, Vaera, section 6. Kohelet Midrash, on “Oppression makes a wise man mad,” gives eighty laws. “I forgot them through attending to communal needs,” says Kohelet Midrash on that verse. [Both checked Midrashim name the teacher Yehudah ben Pedaya.]
